meta.name: pathfinder
meta.description: Map a codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, identify duplicated concerns across features, and propose a unified architecture. Use when asked to "find the ideal path," unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor. Emits a proposed unified flowchart plus per-system /make-plan prompts.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将代码库映射为功能流程图，识别重复并统一架构
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在重构或统一多个重复系统
copy.tagline_en: Map codebase into feature flowcharts, identify duplicates, and unify architecture
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are refactoring or unifying duplicated systems

howto.what: 把代码库按功能分组画成流程图;找出功能内和跨功能重复的逻辑,形成带证据的报告;提出一个统一架构;把每套待改造系统写成可直接交给 /make-plan 的提示。不写实现代码。
howto.when: 当用户要求“find the ideal path”、统一重复的系统,或在重构前做架构审计时触发。

say.text: 把代码按功能分组画流程图,标出重复逻辑。
say.note: 会先做功能发现,再生成各功能流程图。

say.text: 订单和支付模块像是重复系统,请提供统一架构方案。
say.note: 会做跨功能重复检查,并出具带证据的重复报告。

say.text: 重构前先审计这个仓库,并把后续计划写成 /make-plan 提示。
say.note: 结束后给出可直接复制到 /make-plan 的各系统提示。

howto.what_en: Maps the codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts, flags duplicate concerns within and across features, writes an evidence-backed duplication report, proposes a unified architecture, emits per-system /make-plan prompts. No code written.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked to 'find the ideal path', unify duplicated systems, or audit architecture before a refactor.

say_en.text: Map this codebase into feature-grouped flowcharts and flag duplicate logic.
say_en.note: Runs feature discovery and per-feature flowchart generation.

say_en.text: Orders and payments look duplicated, propose a unified architecture.
say_en.note: Runs the duplication hunt and writes a unified proposal.

say_en.text: Audit the codebase architecture before refactor and hand off to /make-plan.
say_en.note: Produces handoff prompt files ready for /make-plan.
